newsitem.title: UK: List of charges faced by Grobbelaar, Segers.
newsitem.headline: List of charges faced by Grobbelaar, Segers.

text.p: Following is a list of charges faced by Bruce Grobbelaar, John Fashanu, Hans Segers and Malaysian businessman Heng Suan Lim.
There are three charges. The first is against Lim, 31, the former Aston Villa striker Fashanu, 34, and the Dutch-born former Wimbledon keeper Segers, 35.

It alleges that between February 1, 1991 and November 9, 1994, they conspired together and with others known and unknown corruptly to give and accept gifts of money "as inducements improperly to influence or attempt to influence the outcome of football matches or as rewards for having done so".
The second count is against Lim, Fashanu and the former Liverpool goalkeeper Grobbelaar, 39, and alleges a similar conspiracy between November 1, 1992, and November 9, 1994.

The third count is against Zimbabwe international Grobbelaar alone. It alleges that while with Southampton football club he corruptly accepted from Christopher Vincent money as an inducement or reward for improperly influencing or attempting to influence the outcome of a football match or matches.
The four pleaded not guilty to the charges.
